readings: areset is a level-sensitive asynchronous reset, active high: while areset=1, the state is forced to walk left regardless of clk and bump inputs.
areset is a positive-edge-triggered reset: the state resets to walk left only on the rising edge of areset; holding areset high does not continuously reset the FSM.
During asynchronous reset, the state is walk left, so walk_left=1 and walk_right=0 immediately (combinational Moore outputs).
During reset, both outputs are forced to 0 until reset is deasserted and a clock edge occurs.
walk_left and walk_right are combinational functions of the current state, so they change in the same cycle as the state update after a clock edge.
walk_left and walk_right are registered outputs, so they change one clock cycle after the state update.
The FSM has an undefined initial state if areset is never asserted; it must be reset before use.
The FSM powers up in the walk left state even without areset.
